notes.title: Devlog #14
notes.content:
With a heavy heart, we are announcing that we'll be postponing this project indefinitely for now.

Here are a few reasons why this has happened:

 Our involvement in the writing of a game development book. This severely affected the preparation of a demo for players, publishers, and investors.
 Technical challenges that would require a very well-defined plan to execute. Due to the first reason, it has become difficult to overcome these issues in a timely manner.
 Thus, the uncertainty in getting this ambitious project funded.


We are not giving up on this project for real. It still has a special place in our hearts and minds. We are simply not in a position to continue the effort. Instead, we'll focus our attention on more feasible projects and hopefully come back to Urban Farmer one day.

The situation has changed for the worse for the time being. Maybe, it will change for the better, so we can start growing our gardens together.
